description: We are conducting a confidential search for a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing facility. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary leader to make a significant impact on patient care and facility success.The successful candidate will be responsible for the overall management and strategic direction of the facility, ensuring the highest standards of quality care, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency. This role demands strong leadership, financial acumen, and a commitment to fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.Join a team committed to excellence and compassionate care. We offer a competitive salary and the chance to advance your career in a supportive setting.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 3-5 years of experience as an LNHA in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities.
Demonstrated leadership abilities and strong communication skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Missouri Valley, IA. This is an excellent opportunity for a Registered Nurse with a passion for patient assessment and care planning to make a significant impact within a supportive environment. We are looking for a long-term commitment, as this is not an interim position.

In this vital role, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring accuracy and compliance with federal and state regulations. You will collaborate closely with the interdisciplinary team to develop comprehensive, individualized care plans that reflect the needs of our residents. Your expertise will be crucial in optimizing resident outcomes and ensuring appropriate reimbursement.
requirements: Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficient knowledge of MDS 3.0 and the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process
Strong understanding of Medicare and Medicaid regulations related to MDS

description:
Join a highly reputable company known for its exceptional employee retention, where professionals build long-lasting careers. We are seeking a dedicated Commercial HVAC Field Manager to oversee operations across the vibrant Chicago Metropolitan Area, including parts of Illinois, Wisconsin, and Indiana. This role offers a unique opportunity to manage critical HVAC systems in diverse commercial settings.

This position involves travel within the specified region, providing essential leadership and technical expertise. If you are a seasoned HVAC professional looking for a stable and rewarding career with a company that values its employees, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Minimum 5-7 years of experience in HVAC.
At least 3 years of commercial HVAC experience, including boilers and chillers.
Ability to travel within the Chicago Metropolitan Area (IL, WI & IN).
Experience in Skilled Nursing Facilities (SNF) is a plus.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $50.00 - $65.00, based on experience.
